{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-k1jp: initiator uses ciphertext instead of plaintext in transcript_4","description":"In `EdhocInitiator::process_message_2_with_credential` (line ~918), `transcript_4` is called with `&ciphertext_3.0` — the **ciphertext** — after `encrypt_in_place_detached` at line 914 has already replaced the plaintext in-place.

**Impact**: P0 correctness bug. Initiator and responder compute different TH_4 values, which means they derive different OSCORE keys. The EDHOC handshake completes successfully (signature verification passes, which uses TH_3, not TH_4), but all subsequent encrypted communication via the derived OSCORE context will fail.

**Evidence**:
- Test at line 1637 passes `plaintext_3` (not ciphertext) to `transcript_4` and asserts expected `th_4`
- Responder at line 1347 correctly passes `pending.plaintext` (decrypted plaintext)
- Initiator at line 918 incorrectly passes `ciphertext_3.0` (encrypted + tag appended)

**Fix**: Save the plaintext (data_3 = CBOR(bstr(pubkey) || bstr(signature))) before the `encrypt_in_place_detached` call at line 914, then pass the saved plaintext to `transcript_4` at line 918.","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T17:34:36.489901665Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T17:34:36.489901665Z"}
